neighbours.label: the preposition that links a stance or feeling noun/adjective to its object ('respect to', 'devotion to', 'satisfaction with', 'saddened by'); the same prepositions in spatial or agentive use stay low
fire: The flags were lowered as a sign of respect to the former mayor.
Fans showed great loyalty to the club during its worst seasons.
The monks lived in complete devotion to their daily prayers.
Customers reported high satisfaction with the faster service.
Many readers were deeply moved by the letters in the final chapter.
Parents voiced their frustration with the new school schedule.
The soldiers swore allegiance to the young queen at her coronation.

Fans travelled by train to the stadium during the winter season.
The monks walked in single file to the chapel every morning.
Customers waited in line with their bags outside the store.
Many readers borrowed the letters from the library in the city centre.
Parents drove their children to the new school each day.
The soldiers rode with the young queen to the coastal fortress.
